title: CiteSight
description: An academic integrity tool for checking student assignments. CiteSight extracts references and in-text citations from PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, and JSON documents, verifies each reference against Crossref, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex, checks cited URLs, validates APA/MLA/Chicago formatting, and flags fabricated, future-dated, or orphaned citations. Distributed as a desktop application, a command-line tool, and a web service. Open source under the MIT licence.
